title: crypto2dev: OPERATION fd pool
description: Implement a pool of reusable OPERATION fds for /dev/crypto2dev. Opening a fresh fd per wolfSSL operation is correct but syscall-heavy; instead maintain a fixed-size pool of open fds and reuse them via CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_RESET between operations. Pool API: acquire(algo, op, key, keylen) → fd; release(fd). On acquire: scan pool for a matching idle fd, call RESET if algo matches, or close+reopen if algo changed. Thread safety via per-slot mutex or spinlock. Pool size configurable at compile time (default 8).
notes: This is foundational — all symmetric, hash, MAC, and KDF operations depend on it. Consider whether pool slots should be per-thread (TLS) or global with locking. Global with per-slot trylock avoids TLS complexity.
